title: India: Dharavi Case Study

concepts.def: Mumbai slum of around 1 million people in just 2.1 km2.
Workshops recycle plastic, leather and pottery, earning ~$1bn/yr.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Dharavi is one of Asia's largest slums.

About 1 million people live on just 2.1 km2.

Density is among the highest on Earth.

It is also a hive of work.

Around 5,000 small businesses recycle plastic, leather and pottery.

The informal economy turns over close to $1 billion a year.

Improvement comes in two flavours.

Top-down: the SRA redevelops blocks into multi-storey flats.

Bottom-up: NGOs run sanitation and skills projects with residents.
